notes: The nine Wildling card names match the physical component list.
Win/loss effects were transcribed from the bundled scans (Rulebook/wildling-cards1..3.webp).
Each branch names one effect the engine resolves automatically. Where the printed card
lets the rewarded player choose (which units to destroy, which track to move to, which
House card to discard, etc.) the engine picks a deterministic default; see docs/roadmap.md.
'chosen' is the lowest bidder when the Wildlings win and the highest bidder when the
Night's Watch wins. 'others' applies to every other participant. A null 'chosen' means
'all' for replace_knights; 999 power means 'all available power'.
Ties for highest/lowest bidder are broken by Iron Throne position (the holder would decide).

wildling_victory.text: LOWEST BIDDER: replaces all of his Knights with available Footmen; any Knight unable to be replaced is destroyed. EVERYONE ELSE: replaces 2 of their Knights with available Footmen; any Knight unable to be replaced is destroyed.

nights_watch_victory.text: HIGHEST BIDDER: may immediately replace up to 2 of his Footmen, anywhere, with available Knights.

wildling_victory.text: LOWEST BIDDER: destroys 2 of his units at one of his Castles or Strongholds; if unable, he destroys 2 of his units anywhere. EVERYONE ELSE: destroys 1 of their units anywhere.

nights_watch_victory.text: HIGHEST BIDDER: may muster forces (following normal mustering rules) in any one Castle or Stronghold area he controls.

wildling_victory.text: LOWEST BIDDER: moves his tokens to the lowest position of every Influence track. EVERYONE ELSE: in turn order, each player chooses either the Fiefdoms or King's Court track and moves his token to the lowest position of that track.

nights_watch_victory.text: HIGHEST BIDDER: moves his token to the top of one Influence track of his choice, then takes the appropriate Dominance token.

wildling_victory.text: LOWEST BIDDER: destroys 3 of his units anywhere. EVERYONE ELSE: destroys 2 of their units anywhere.

nights_watch_victory.text: HIGHEST BIDDER: may retrieve 1 House card of his choice from his House card discard pile.

wildling_victory.text: LOWEST BIDDER: if he has more than one House card in his hand, he discards all cards with the highest combat strength. EVERYONE ELSE: if they have more than one House card in their hand, they must choose and discard one of these cards.

nights_watch_victory.text: HIGHEST BIDDER: returns his entire House card discard pile into his hand.

wildling_victory.text: LOWEST BIDDER: chooses one of the following: A) destroys 2 of his units anywhere, or B) is reduced 2 positions on his highest Influence track. EVERYONE ELSE: nothing happens.

nights_watch_victory.text: HIGHEST BIDDER: the wildlings immediately attack again with a strength of 6. You do not participate in the bidding against this attack (nor do you receive any rewards or penalties).

wildling_victory.text: LOWEST BIDDER: is reduced 2 positions on the Supply track (to no lower than 0). EVERYONE ELSE: is reduced 1 position on the Supply track (to no lower than 0). Then reconcile armies to their new Supply limits.

nights_watch_victory.text: HIGHEST BIDDER: is increased 1 position on the Supply track (to no higher than 6).

wildling_victory.text: LOWEST BIDDER: nothing happens. EVERYONE ELSE: nothing happens.
LOWEST BIDDER: discards all available Power tokens. EVERYONE ELSE: discards 2 available Power tokens, or as many as they are able.

nights_watch_victory.text: HIGHEST BIDDER: all Power tokens he bid on this attack are immediately returned to his available Power.
